compiled_state.title: As an orchestrator, I compute cited_lines_fingerprint and emit severity-history telemetry per finding
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement fingerprint = SHA-256 of <path>:<line>:<whitespace-collapsed-content> for each cited line, computed orchestrator-side at defense-write time. Append severity_history[] entry per cycle to the defense record. Wire review-stats.sh to emit p90_cycle_count, phantom_escalation_rate, prior_region_resustain_skew, call2_finding_drop_rate.
**Why**: SC1 telemetry + SC3 fingerprint. Orchestrator-side computation prevents reviewer-emitted hash drift.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - Fingerprint helper function in shared review library
  - DefenseStore record schema includes severity_history[]
  - review-stats.sh emits the four named metrics with appropriate aggregation windows
  - Whitespace-only line changes preserve fingerprint (test fixture)
  OUT:
  - Forward telemetry response playbook (S16)
  - Mirror semantics (S13)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, every defense record carries an orchestrator-computed cited_lines_fingerprint; review-stats.sh emits the four named telemetry metrics
  ← Satisfies: "Stateful re-review with two-call reviewer architecture, orchestrator-side proximity-overlap verification, and severity-history telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Line-number drift from positional rebases voids fingerprint without semantic change (red team #7) — accepted constraint; follow-on bug if telemetry shows excessive releases on unchanged content

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
